faq.q: What is County Line Glen Valley?
faq.a: A Fraser Valley board sub-area in the Township of Langley — rural acreage country of equestrian estates, hobby farms and multi-acre parcels. It is one of eleven Langley sub-areas in the SnapStats data, on the Township side of the combined Langley board community (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: How active is the County Line Glen Valley market?
faq.a: Very thin in the published data: in September 2026 the sub-area recorded 0 detached active listings with 1 sold (sales ratio NA, as published — a sale against zero snapshot inventory, not a trend), and 0 Condos & Townhomes listings with 0 sold. Langley community context for the same month was 449 detached listings / 64 solds and 699 attached listings / 128 solds (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: What is the median price in County Line Glen Valley?
faq.a: SnapStats does not publish a sub-area median — medians exist at community level only, and the Langley community medians for September 2026 were $1,345,000 detached and $611,000 for Condos & Townhomes. Those are community figures, not this sub-area's figures; the live feed's first page ran from $1,975,000 to $7,999,900, which is feed data, not a median (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Can a Glen Valley acreage have a second home or a suite?
faq.a: It depends on ALR status and Township zoning, parcel by parcel. On ALR land, the ALC frame allows one principal residence up to 500 m² plus at most one additional detached residence of 90 m² (parcels 40 ha or less) or 186 m² (over 40 ha), with a suite only inside the principal residence; under Township Zoning Bylaw No. 2500 a secondary suite is capped at 120 m² gross floor area, one per principal unit (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/rules-gaps-2026-11-01.md, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: Which schools serve County Line Glen Valley?
faq.a: SD35 Langley schools in or near the sub-area confirmed by name and address against the BC Ministry K-12 file include Coghlan Fundamental Elementary (4452 256th St), Wix-Brown Elementary (23851 24 Ave), North Otter Elementary (5370 248 St), Peterson Road Elementary (23422 47 Ave) and D.W. Poppy Secondary (23752 52 Ave). Catchments are address-based and no rural locator result is on record in this program, so confirm any address with the SD35 School Locator (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).
